d:
A voice, a message, an emotion, Main Zinda Hoon is a song from a shaheed soldier to every Indian. Feel goosebumps as all your feelings come alive.
Song - Main Zinda Hoon
Singer - Sonu Nigam
Music - Anu Malik
Lyrics - Javed Akhtar
Music Production & Song Arranged by Prasad Sashte
Solo Violin - Suresh Lalwani
Guitars - Dabbu
